steps.name: adapter-contract-foundation
steps.summary: shared adapter foundation에 JSON-safe outbox serializer, checkout topic resolver, transaction/session Protocol, retry backoff config, PostgreSQL schema 초안, adapter env key와 import boundary 테스트를 추가했다.

steps.name: postgres-outbox-idempotency
steps.summary: PostgreSQL outbox/idempotency adapter 패키지와 fake connection 기반 계약 테스트를 추가해 outbox READY/FAILED→PUBLISHING→PUBLISHED/FAILED 전이와 processed message/command 중복 감지를 검증했다.

steps.name: postgres-context-repositories
steps.summary: inventory/payment/store approval context에 injected PostgreSQL connection 기반 aggregate repository adapter와 fake connection round-trip/missing lookup/transaction boundary 테스트를 추가했다.

steps.name: outbox-relay-kafka-publisher
steps.summary: OutboxRelay와 Kafka publisher boundary를 추가해 READY/FAILED outbox claim, PUBLISHING→PUBLISHED/FAILED 전이, payload JSON 및 correlation/causation/message/command header 보존을 테스트로 검증했다.

steps.name: kafka-listener-adapters
steps.summary: Kafka inbound listener adapter를 추가해 checkout event→process manager→outbox command 저장, inventory/payment/store approval command dispatch, processed message/command 중복 무시와 malformed payload 거부를 fake 기반 테스트로 검증했다.

steps.name: wallet-blockchain-boundaries
steps.summary: wallet signature verifier, blockchain gas/receipt adapter, transaction signature/refund service를 injected client boundary로 추가하고 fake client 기반 테스트로 MetaMask recover, gas estimate, transaction receipt, refund receipt mapping을 검증했다.

steps.name: adapter-infrastructure-verification
steps.summary: adapter infrastructure public contract 테스트와 README/app README 정리를 추가해 shared PostgreSQL/Kafka/outbox, context adapter, wallet/blockchain boundary exports와 dependency/env/schema/compose 정합성을 검증했다.
